daily.title: Breaking: Jaymie Graham named new North Melbourne AFL coach
daily.summary: North Melbourne confirms that Fremantle assistant coach Jaymie Graham is the new Kangaroos coach, succeeding Alastair Clarkson.

daily.title: Nurse used 'unreasonable' force against aged care resident, tribunal rules
daily.summary: A registered nurse who grabbed, pushed and dragged an aged care resident with dementia has been banned from practising for two years for using "completely unreasonable and unnecessary" force.

daily.title: Farmer uses $5,000 ram to start conversations about prostate cancer
daily.summary: Kojonup farmer Liz Heggaton raises thousands of dollars for prostate cancer awareness through her annual ram sale, after losing her husband to the disease in 2024.

daily.title: Meet the pianist who is part of a family of seven musical siblings
daily.summary: From sibling banter to performance anxiety, Isata Kanneh-Mason discusses family, learning from Elton John, and why classical music remains relevant to young people.

daily.title: Nepal focuses on rehabilitation as it ends rescue operation after flood
daily.summary: Nepal has ended the search-and-rescue operation for the more than 5,000 people still missing after the devastating August flood.

daily.title: Man in 20s dies after being stabbed in neck in North Albury
daily.summary: A police strike force has been set up to investigate the death of a man found stabbed in North Albury last month.

daily.title: Budding rocket scientists put designs to the test in outback competition
daily.summary: Domestic and international students turn a remote sheep station into a testing ground for their designs as they compete in the Australian Universities Rocket Competition.

daily.title: Australian Army soldier dies in training exercise
daily.summary: An Australian Army soldier has died and five others have been injured during a training exercise at Mount Bundey, south-east of Darwin.

daily.title: Man carjacked at knifepoint on Sunshine Coast, sparking 160km police chase
daily.summary: Two men have been charged over an alleged carjacking on the Sunshine Coast that led to a police pursuit through the evening.

daily.title: Landmark gorge reopens to visitors after 'huge job' fixing flood damage
daily.summary: Danggu Geikie Gorge is welcoming its first visitors in more than three years, after the devastating Fitzroy River Floods destroyed almost all its infrastructure.

daily.title: Smooth sailing for new passenger zones at Melbourne Airport
daily.summary: The new pick-up and drop-off zones have largely met with passenger approval on the first morning of operation.

daily.title: Court hears man ran over partner with Range Rover, causing brain injury
daily.summary: The Northern Territory Supreme Court has heard a woman suffered life-threatening injuries, including facial fractures, brain bleeds and wounds to her body after being run over by her partner in rural Darwin.

daily.title: Record sheep prices can't save saleyard despite $1 lease offer
daily.summary: Despite record sheep prices the Jerilderie saleyard will be decommissioned after Murrumbidgee Council failed to find anyone to take over its 20-year lease offered for just $1 per year.

daily.title: Mary Fowler withdraws from Matildas squad for Germany, Haiti games
daily.summary: Mary Fowler will be replaced by Leah Davidson for the upcoming friendlies, with the Matildas star withdrawing due to personal circumstances.

daily.title: Live: Wantaway Saints star boycotts best and fairest as Cats eye AFL trade
daily.summary: St Kilda ruck Rowan Marshall does not attend the Saints' best and fairest event as he tries to force through a trade to Geelong. Follow all the news and debate from the AFL trade period in our live blog.

daily.title: Trump's former press secretary Karoline Leavitt joins Fox News
daily.summary: Karoline Leavitt, the youngest person to hold the role of press secretary, is joining Fox News as an on-air contributor in November.

daily.title: WA has high hopes for Land Forces as anti-war activists prepare to protest
daily.summary: Australia's biggest defence expo is making its debut in Perth with the WA government saying it is important "strategically, commercially" as anti-war activists prepare to protest.

daily.title: UK author and politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
daily.summary: Jeffrey Archer was a best-selling author who sold more than 300 million copies worldwide, with his final novel due to be published this month.

daily.title: Bird flu adds to fears for threatened species at proposed wind farm site
daily.summary: Victorian ecologists are warning of the "compounding risks" of bird flu and a proposal for the nation's tallest wind turbines on threatened species.

daily.title: Violence-racked remote NT community appeals for social club trial
daily.summary: Residents of the Northern Territory's second-largest remote community are divided over whether a social club should be opened and serve alcohol, amid ongoing violence in the town.

daily.title: Live: ASX rises, Nasdaq hits new record high
daily.summary: The Australian share market opens higher. The Nasdaq hit a record high after Wall Street's tech stocks surged. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: The people and programs trying to tackle homelessness in Lakes Entrance
daily.summary: The Victorian region synonymous with boating, tourism and recreational camping is now home to a growing number of rough sleepers.

daily.title: Data breaches across Queensland's public sector on the rise
daily.summary: The Office of the Information Commissioner says some of the breaches were malicious and intentional.

daily.title: Live: Coalition expected to cut migration to 100,000 in first year if elected
daily.summary: The Coalition is expected to announce it will cut net overseas migration to 100,000 in its first year of government. Follow live.

daily.title: Demon faces Djokovic in China final after Medvedev disqualified
daily.summary: Drama at the China Open as Daniil Medvedev is disqualified for hitting a spectator with a tennis ball, while Australia's Alex de Minaur reaches the final after his opponent retires due to injury.

developing.title: Live: ASX to fall slightly as Australian dollar weakens after RBA rate hike
developing.summary: The ASX is likely to start its day flat, or even slightly lower. It comes after a weak session on Wall Street as government bond yields continued their march towards multi-decade highs. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Taylor blames 'home-grown inflation' for 15-year-high rate hike
developing.summary: The opposition leader says the government is not in control of inflation and interest rates. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Nathan Cleary accepts maiden Dally M Medal from his dad's couch
developing.summary: Injured Penrith superstar Nathan Cleary has claimed his maiden Dally M Medal, with Brisbane fullback Tamika Upton taking the NRLW award for the third time in four seasons. Follow live.

developing.title: What we know about the terrifying flydubai flight to Israel
developing.summary: One pilot stabbed another and attempted to crash a flight, according to Israel's prime minister, with one passenger who intervened praised as a "hero".

developing.title: Live: ASX to fall, price of oil surges
developing.summary: ASX set to fall while the oil price stays stubbornly in the green. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Shoebridge wants Greens members to directly elect party leaders by 2028
developing.summary: Greens leader David Shoebridge commits to having members directly elect the party's leadership by the next federal election. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Young girl critical as car hits grand final gathering, injuring 10
developing.summary: A car has crashed into a crowd of Newcastle Knights supporters as they lined the streets to cheer on the team bus as it travelled to Sydney ahead of Sunday's NRL grand final.

developing.title: Live: Early error hands Roosters lead in NRLW grand final
developing.summary: For the fourth time in nine NRLW seasons, the Roosters and Broncos meet on grand final day with three greats of the game hanging up their boots. Follow live.
